meta.tldr: Planning day for Omadesign: a public hardening plan covering unsafe code, build speed, and worktree cleanup, plus three early-morning X replies

shipped.title: Omadesign · hardening plan filed
shipped.summary: Opened a public tracking issue from an audit of the Omadesign codebase, turning the findings into a checklist for safer native code, faster builds, and automatic cleanup of stale build artifacts and worktrees.
bullets: Unsafe code: only 11 real blocks live in Omadesign's own source (LibRaw and lcms2 bindings); the plan wraps them in small documented blocks and denies unsafe code crate-wide elsewhere
Build speed: line-tables-only debug info measured 15% faster clean builds, 19% faster core rebuilds, and a 44% smaller target directory
Longer term: move the native bindings into their own crate, then split the single crate into a workspace, the biggest build-time win
Cleanup: a preview-by-default script for merged worktrees, stale build folders, and old release builds, plus a weekly timer
